notes: Identity independently checked from canonical text: research article titled The Link Between Self-Dehumanization and Immoral Behavior; Maryam Kouchaki, Kyle S. H. Dobson, Adam Waytz, Nour S. Kteily; Psychological Science 2018, 29(8), 1234–1246; DOI 10.1177/0956797618760784. Matching primary report with article body and references, rather than an abstract-only excerpt. No PDF supplied. Assigned fields only: n_o and es_value_o; replication, original p, and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Study 1a and page locator identify the three-condition self-dehumanization ANOVA; its printed effect metric is partial eta-squared, retained without conversion despite requested etasq. Results also give pairwise comparisons (unethical versus neutral p = .064; unethical versus ethical p = .022; ethical versus neutral p = .61), without a printed effect size for those contrasts; these are distinct from the omnibus ANOVA. The same-test omnibus p = .033 is included literally in effect evidence, while unassigned p.value remains null. Analytic N = 156 is explicitly printed, not inferred from df or summed groups; group counts are corroborating context only.
